description:
## About EFG

EFG International is a global private banking group, serving clients in over 40 locations worldwide. As EFG continues to grow, we are building a talent pool for future Client Services Officer (CSO) positions in Geneva. Joining our talent pool means you will be among the first considered for upcoming opportunities, contributing to our dynamic and inclusive environment.

EFG is committed to equity, inclusion, and mutual respect. We value diversity as a driver of innovation and better decision-making, and we strive to be an employer of choice.

## Skills and Experience

- Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar role within private banking or financial services.

- Strong understanding of private banking processes, financial products, and regulatory requirements (KYC, AML, FATCA, CRS).

- Excellent proficiency in English and French; additional languages are an asset.

- Proficient in standard IT systems; adaptable to new software.

- Service-oriented, client-focused mindset; strong team player.

- High level of confidentiality and discretion.

- Proactive, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and reliable.

- Open-minded and eager to learn.

## Our Values

-  Accountability:  Ownership and continuous improvement.

-  Hands-on:  Proactive delivery of high-quality results.

-  Passionate:  Commitment and pursuit of excellence.

-  Solution-driven:  Focus on client outcomes and fair treatment.

-  Partnership-oriented:  Collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit.

## Please ensure to attach a cover letter to your CV when filling the application.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su EFG

EFG International è un gruppo bancario privato globale, che serve clienti in oltre 40 sedi in tutto il mondo. Mentre EFG continua a crescere, stiamo costruendo un pool di talenti per le future posizioni di Client Services Officer (CSO) a Ginevra. Unire il nostro pool di talenti significa che sarete tra i primi considerati per le prossime opportunità, contribuendo al nostro ambiente dinamico e inclusivo.

EFG si impegna a equità, inclusione e rispetto reciproco. Noi apprezziamo la diversità come un driver di innovazione e un migliore processo decisionale, e ci sforziamo di essere un datore di lavoro di scelta.

Competenze ed Esperienza
- Esperienza minima di 5 anni in un ruolo simile all’interno dei servizi bancari privati o finanziari.
- Forte comprensione dei processi bancari privati, dei prodotti finanziari e dei requisiti normativi (KYC, AML, FATCA, CRS).
- Ottima competenza in inglese e francese; lingue aggiuntive sono un bene.
- Proficiente nei sistemi IT standard; adattabile al nuovo software.

- mentalità orientata al servizio, orientata al cliente; forte giocatore di squadra.
- Alto livello di riservatezza e discrezione.
- Proattiva, automotivata, orientata al dettaglio e affidabile.
- Di mentalità aperta e desideroso di imparare.

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: ProprietÃ e miglioramento continuo.
- Hands-on: Consegna attiva di risultati di alta qualità.
- Passionato: Impegno e perseguimento dell'eccellenza.
- Soluzione-driven: Focus sui risultati del cliente e sul trattamento equo.
- Partnership-oriented: collaborazione e spirito imprenditoriale.

Si prega di assicurarsi di allegare una lettera di copertura al CV durante la compilazione dell'applicazione.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Über EFG

EFG International ist eine globale Privatbankgruppe, die Kunden an über 40 Standorten weltweit bedient. Da die EFG weiter wächst, bauen wir in Genf einen Talentpool für zukünftige Kundendienste Officer (CSO) Positionen. Mit unserem Talentpool werden Sie zu den ersten in Betracht kommenden Möglichkeiten kommen und zu unserer dynamischen und inklusiven Umgebung beitragen.

EFG setzt sich für Eigenkapital, Inklusion und gegenseitige Achtung ein. Wir schätzen Vielfalt als Innovationstreiber und eine bessere Entscheidungsfindung, und wir bemühen uns, Arbeitgeber der Wahl zu sein.

Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle bei privaten Bank- oder Finanzdienstleistungen.
- Ein starkes Verständnis für private Bankprozesse, Finanzprodukte und regulatorische Anforderungen (KYC, AML, FATCA, CRS).
- Ausgezeichnete Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Gut.
- Proficient in Standard-IT-Systemen; an neue Software anpassbar.
- Serviceorientiertes, kundenorientiertes Mindset; starker Teamplayer.
- Hohe Vertraulichkeit und Diskretion.
- Proaktiv, selbstmotiviert, detailorientiert und zuverlässig.
- Offene und eifrig zu lernen.

Unsere Werte
- Buchhaltung: Eigentum und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
- Hands-on: Proaktive Lieferung hochwertiger Ergebnisse.
- Leidenschaftlich: Engagement und Streben nach Exzellenz.
- Lösungsgetrieben: Fokus auf Kundenergebnisse und faire Behandlung.
- Partnerschaftsorientiert: Zusammenarbeit und Unternehmergeist.

Bitte stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie beim Ausfüllen der Bewerbung einen Brief an Ihren Lebenslauf anbringen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos de l'EFG

EFG International est un groupe mondial de banques privées qui dessert plus de 40 clients dans le monde entier. À mesure que l'EFG continue de croître, nous établissons un bassin de talents pour les futurs postes d'agent des services à la clientèle (OSC) à Genève. En vous joignant à notre bassin de talents, vous serez parmi les premiers considérés pour les prochaines opportunités, contribuant ainsi à notre environnement dynamique et inclusif.

EFG s'engage en faveur de l'équité, de l'inclusion et du respect mutuel. Nous valorisons la diversité en tant que moteur de l'innovation et d'une meilleure prise de décision, et nous nous efforçons d'être un employeur de choix.

Compétences et expérience
- Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire au sein de la banque privée ou des services financiers.
- Une bonne compréhension des processus bancaires privés, des produits financiers et des exigences réglementaires (KYC, AML, FATCA, CRS).
- Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais et du français; d'autres langues sont un atout.
- Connaissance des systèmes informatiques standard; adaptation aux nouveaux logiciels.
- Un état d'esprit axé sur le service et le client; un joueur fort.
- Niveau élevé de confidentialité et de discrétion.
- Proactive, automotivée, axée sur les détails et fiable.
- Ouvert et désireux d'apprendre.

Nos valeurs
- Responsabilité : propriété et amélioration continue.
- Hands-on: Livraison proactive de résultats de haute qualité.
- Passionné : Engagement et recherche de l'excellence.
- La solution est axée sur les résultats des clients et un traitement équitable.
- Objectif partenariat : Collaboration et esprit d'entreprise.

Veuillez joindre une lettre d'accompagnement à votre CV au moment de remplir la demande.

sections.heading: About EFG
paragraphs: EFG International is a global private banking group, serving clients in over 40 locations worldwide. As EFG continues to grow, we are building a talent pool for future Client Services Officer (CSO) positions in Geneva. Joining our talent pool means you will be among the first considered for upcoming opportunities, contributing to our dynamic and inclusive environment.
EFG is committed to equity, inclusion, and mutual respect. We value diversity as a driver of innovation and better decision-making, and we strive to be an employer of choice.

sections.heading: Our Purpose and Mission
paragraphs: Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.
We offer personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success depends on our people and our partnerships with clients and communities.

sections.heading: Candidate Communication: What to Expect
paragraphs: As part of our talent pool, your profile will be reviewed for a variety of CSO opportunities as they become available. The private banking market is dynamic, and the requirements for each role may shift in response to client needs, regulatory changes, or business priorities. We value candidates who are adaptable and open to evolving responsibilities.

If your profile matches the requirements for a specific opening, you may be pre-selected and invited to complete an additional questionnaire. This helps us better understand your experience, skills, and career preferences, ensuring a strong fit for both you and EFG.
